§6Fluiduct§f

§aPipe fluids between tanks and machines through a pressurized network!§f

§bFluiducts§f carry one fluid type per network. Throughput depends on fluid viscosity (§e80–600 mB/tick§f) and network pressure, full network runs max, empty runs half.

§6Crafting§f:
§b• Transparent§f: §e1× Copper Ingot§f + §e1× Glass§f → §e6× Fluiduct§f.
§b• Opaque§f: §e1× Copper Ingot§f + §e1× Lead Ingot§f → §e6× Fluiduct (Opaque)§f.

Transparent fluiducts glow when carrying luminous fluids like lava or §bEnergized Glowstone§f, handy as a visual indicator. Attach §bServos§f to pull fluids from inventories, and §bFilters§f to keep fluid types separated on shared lines.

§cWARNING:§f Basic fluiducts break with extreme-temperature fluids (lava, Gelid Cryotheum). Use §bHardened Fluiducts§f for those.
